description: Daily FX reference rates between USD, MXN, COP and ARS, one row per date and ordered currency pair (rate = target units per source unit). Reserved for customer-facing conversions, labeled as such (no tool converts amounts yet); transactions.amount_usd uses the source's fixed rates instead (issue 12). Typed and checked from workspace.bronze.daily_exchange_rates.

load.notes: Single CSV re-delivered in full (13,164 rows vs 3,000 documented: 12 ordered pairs per day, not 3).

date.description: Rate date (2023-06-17 to 2026-06-17, every calendar day). Primary key with the currency pair.

exchange_rate.description: Mid rate: target_currency units per 1 source_currency. Flat within about +/-2% of a constant over three years (synthetic; no ARS devaluation). The two directions of a pair are drawn independently (their product ranges 0.96-1.04).

buy_rate.description: Bank buy rate (at or below the mid rate).

sell_rate.description: Bank sell rate (at or above the mid rate).

source.description: Rate provider; varies from day to day within a pair, so it cannot be used to pick a series.

checks.name: exchange_rate_positive
checks.description: Typed mid rate is present and positive; a missing or non-positive rate cannot convert anything.

checks.name: buy_sell_positive
checks.description: Typed buy and sell rates are present and positive.

checks.name: currencies_differ
checks.description: A pair converts between two different currencies.

checks.name: date_not_in_future
checks.description: No rate is published for a future date.
